cli.help.line1: Apivator CLI — runs collections on the command line and in CI.
cli.help.line7: A file (Postman v2.1 or a .json exported from Apivator) or the name or id of a collection on the server.
cli.help.line7b: The server needs --server and --api-key (or APIVATOR_SERVER and APIVATOR_API_KEY).
cli.help.line9: Exit codes: 0 success, 1 failed test or request, 2 usage or connection error.
cli.help.opt_environment: -e, --environment <file|name|id>  Environment (name or id on the server)
cli.help.opt_globals: -g, --globals <file>              Globals file (the workspace globals are used automatically on the server)
cli.help.opt_iteration_data: -d, --iteration-data <file>       CSV or JSON data file; each row is one iteration
cli.help.opt_bail: --bail                        Stop at the first failed request or test
cli.help.opt_insecure: -k, --insecure                    Do not verify the SSL certificate
cli.help.opt_ca_cert: --ca-cert <file>              Additional CA certificate to trust (PEM/CRT/DER; repeatable)
cli.help.opt_workspace: -w, --workspace <name|id>         Look for the collection in this workspace
cli.help.opt_no_report: --no-report                   Do not save the result to the server
cli.help.opt_suppress_exit_code: --suppress-exit-code          Exit with 0 even if tests fail
cli.help.opt_verbose: --verbose                     Also print the script console output
cli.help.opt_lang: --lang <tr|en>                Interface language (APIVATOR_LANG; default: operating system language)
cli.help.opt_no_color: --no-color                    Do not use colored output (NO_COLOR is also honored)
cli.error.collection_required: Specify the collection to run: apivator run <file|name|id>
cli.error.number_range: --{name} must be a number between {min} and {max}.
cli.error.bad_pair: Variable must be in key=value form: {text}
cli.error.server_required: Server and API key are required: --server and --api-key (or APIVATOR_SERVER, APIVATOR_API_KEY).
cli.error.server_and_key: A server needs both --server and --api-key (or APIVATOR_SERVER and APIVATOR_API_KEY).
cli.error.not_a_file: "{path}" is not a file. To run a collection on the server, provide --server and --api-key (or APIVATOR_SERVER, APIVATOR_API_KEY).
cli.error.environment_not_found: Environment not found: {name}. Available in this workspace: {available}
cli.error.environment_ambiguous: There is more than one environment named "{name}"; specify its id.
cli.error.data_unreadable: Could not read the data file ({path}): {message}
cli.error.collection_not_found: Collection not found: "{name}". To see what you can access: apivator list
cli.error.collection_ambiguous: There is more than one collection named "{name}" ({workspaces}). Provide --workspace or use its id.
cli.report_saved: Report saved to the server; it appears in the runner history in Apivator with the "From CLI" label.
cli.warning.report_not_saved: Warning: could not save the report to the server: {message}
cli.server.unauthorized: The API key is invalid, revoked or expired. Create a new one in Apivator under Account > API keys.
cli.server.forbidden: You do not have permission for this operation.
cli.server.not_found: Not found or you do not have access.
cli.html.title: Apivator report
